titles.en: Inscription for the Jin Shrine, Tang original

productionDate.original: 唐贞观二十年（646）正月二十六日

dimensions.raw: 高 195 厘米，宽 120 厘米，厚 27 厘米
dimensions.note: Body measurements given by the curator.

currentCollection.note: Stands in the 贞观宝翰亭 inside the shrine, beside the 1772 recarving.
currentCollection.noteZh: 立于祠内贞观宝翰亭，与清乾隆三十七年摹刻并立。

date.original: 北宋太平兴国九年（984），推测
date.note: The curator presents this as a likelihood.

provenanceEvents.summary: Probably moved into the shrine when the Sacred Mother Hall was built; earlier records place the stone on a street in Jinyang.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 很可能在兴建圣母殿时移入晋祠；更早的记载称此碑在晋阳县乾阳门街。

review.note: Draft object record from an interview transcript. The 984 move is a hypothesis in the source and is labeled as such.
review.noteZh: 依据访谈整理的草稿；984 年迁移在来源中是推测，本条照录并标注为推测。

notes: The curator gives measurements and a condition summary but no weight or conservation record.
The lower third of the text is reported as worn; the extent has not been measured independently.
The source does not list the seven signatures on the reverse in full.
notesZh: 受访者给出尺寸与保存概况，但没有重量或保护修复记录。
据称碑文下部三分之一剥落较多，剥损范围未做独立量测。
来源没有完整列出碑阴七位功臣的题名。
